description: Golden fault statements for retrieval and triage evaluation (plan P5/P7). Synthetic wording, no customer data. 'expected' lists the articles a good retriever puts in the top 3; any one of them counts as a hit. 'scope' lists the session's product scope tokens (empty = universal articles only). 'class' is the expected triage outcome class: troubleshoot (in scope, grounded), out_of_scope (the scope guard refuses before any model call).
